title: Enforce the localhost request boundary
summary: Reject requests whose Host header does not resolve to localhost, loopback IPv4, or loopback IPv6.
rationale: Binding to loopback limits direct network exposure, but Host validation is also required to prevent a browser on a malicious site from reaching the service through DNS rebinding.

decisions.summary: Validate the Host header before parsing or dispatching any route.
decisions.rationale: Every API and static endpoint shares the same local-only trust boundary, so enforcement belongs at the server entry point.

risks.summary: A remote page could use DNS rebinding to send browser requests to the loopback service and read repository artifacts or diffs.
risks.mitigation: Reject every request whose Host hostname is not localhost, 127.0.0.1, or ::1.

validation.summary: Rejects attacker-controlled Host headers while preserving localhost review, validation, assets, and diff endpoints.
The finalized localhost hardening stage and all prior artifacts remain processable.
